text:
zoe: quick thread to land a small Q2 slice: customers require 1) stable egress IPs for allowlists and 2) upgrades that don't cause support spikes. want to ship an opt-in preserve-egress mode + basic operator canary.
alej: agreed. field has 4 customers blocking on this (bank + healthcare notably).
mike: engineering split: (A) installer handshake & manifest so netops can sign off; (B) runtime SNAT-preserve mode to avoid changing outbound IP during node churn; (C) operator canary with rollback.
zoe: proposed minimal deliverables (MVS):
- Handshake: installer flag --preserve-egress + handshake artifact written to /var/lib/redwood/handshake.json; quick audit event.
- Preserve mode: automated e2e that verifies single stable outbound IP before/after node restart and operator upgrade (httpbin echo).
- Canary: staged rollout 10/50/100 with health gates (latency/error/CRD migration) and rollback hook.
support-bot: CI: packaging-e2e job failing on operator-canary (timeout on canary probe) https://ci.internal/packaging-e2e/3301
alej: risks: CNI differences (Calico/Cilium/host-network), NAT gateway pools causing multiple egress IPs, CRD schema migrations. plan to run shim tests across CNIs and include an adapter for CRD changes.
mike: rough timeline (parallel work): handshake + docs 2w; egress-preserve spike+MVP 3-4w; canary controller 4-6w. runbook and pilot outreach parallel.
zoe: prioritization: P0 preserve-egress + runbook/pilot; P1 canary automation; P2 proxy fallback and IPAM integrations. votes?
alej: +1 P0. banks need this first.
mike: agree. request 1-week CRD migration spike to run in parallel with egress work.
zoe: decision: start P0 now, run CRD spike in parallel. owners: handshake = @alej, preserve = @mike, runbook/pilot = @zoe. target internal pilot in 5 weeks.
alej: I'll open the RFC with schema and installer example.
mike: I'll draft CNI shim design and add smoke test: curl httpbin from each node pre/post upgrade and assert single IP.
zoe: I'll draft the pilot runbook and schedule a 30m sync next Tue. infra: please run packaging-e2e daily on preserve branch until pilot.
support-bot: packaging-e2e scheduled daily on branch preserve-egress until pilot.
